summary_1line: Ravana uses a magician’s illusion of Rama’s severed head and bow to convince Sita that Rama and his allies have been slain.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the Ashoka grove, the demon magician drops an illusionary severed head of Rama before the grief-stricken Sita seated on the ground.
Ravana stands proudly holding Rama’s great bow while captive Sita sits beneath the Ashoka trees surrounded by grim demoness guards.
Sita sits with bowed head in the Ashoka grove, thin and sorrowful, watched by grotesque titan women as Ravana approaches.
